name: An Evening Market At Troy-TX
tagline: Evening Market at Troy in Troy, TX
description: An Evening Market At Troy-TX gathers local farms and food producers in 201 East Main Street, TX. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
